args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Vacation Itinerary (June 10-20, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Sunscreen (high SPF, reef-safe recommended)
- Hiking gear (comfortable shoes, light backpack)
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable clothing)
- Camera or smartphone with waterproof case
- Travel documents (ID, passport if needed, hotel confirmations)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses and hat
- Light rain jacket (for possible showers)
- Snorkeling gear (if not renting)
- Insect repellent
- Reusable water bottle
- Flip flops/sandals
- Evening attire for the Luau (June 16)
- Spa wear for relaxation day (June 17)
- Shopping bag for Ala Moana Center (June 19)
